2026-07-23 04:31:20.207479 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-07-23 04:31:20.207492 | controller |
2026-07-23 04:31:20.207496 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-07-23 04:31:20.207500 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-07-23 04:31:20.207504 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-07-23 04:31:20.207507 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-07-23 04:31:20.207510 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-07-23 04:31:20.207514 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-07-23 04:31:20.207517 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
